name: admob-policy
description: Full catalog of AdMob, Google Publisher, and Google Play ads policy violations with the concrete Android code fix for each: Modified ad behavior, accidental clicks, unexpected interstitials, ad density, inventory value, rewards user choice, invalid traffic, refresh rate limits, incentivized clicks, app-ads.txt, EU consent, privacy disclosures, COPPA / Designed for Families, content policies, Publisher Restrictions, and Play's separate disruptive / out-of-context ads track.
